answer: Quartz plots: each identity must keep its own unique 2 GB storage plot, filled from a seed bound to its key and sealed slowly enough that it can't be regenerated on demand. At random moments peers ask for a few hashed chunks and require replies within 2 seconds. One honest agent is a small oasis of disk; a farm of a thousand clones needs a thousand plots, an ocean of storage that grows linearly. Plots that hash identically count as one identity and share one reward.
